artworks.title: Claude Deruet and his Son, Jean
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27 × 16.8 cm (10 5/8 × 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures in a detailed etching. The adult figure stands with their body facing forward but with their head turned towards the viewer, their left hand gesturing slightly upward while holding the hand of the child standing beside them. The adult has long, wavy hair and a full beard. Their facial features are distinctly detailed with sharp lines typical of etchings. They wear ornate clothing with abundant texture and decorative patterns, including a lavish coat, knee-length breeches, and elegant boots. The clothing is accentuated with intricate patterns and appears to be of noble style. The child beside the adult also has long, curly hair and wears a small hat adorned with feathers, a cape, a jacket, knickerbockers, and similar styled shoes. The child is carrying what appears to be a part of an artistic tool or walking stick. The background reveals a detailed cityscape with various buildings, streets, and people. Above the figures are heavy drapes framing the top of the image, and a coat of arms is prominently displayed between them.

artworks.title: The Martyrs of Japan
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.5 × 11 cm (6 1/2 × 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mass crucifixion scene with figures mounted on crosses. The detailed drawing depicts an array of crucifixions where multiple figures in robes are fastened to crosses that rise above a mass of soldiers and onlookers below. The figures on the crosses are depicted with serene expressions, and above them, angels or other heavenly figures float amidst clouds in the sky. The crowd beneath the crosses includes soldiers wielding spears and onlookers who appear to be part of the spectacle.

artworks.title: The Camp
artworks.description: This image depicts a military encampment from a bird's-eye view. In the foreground, there are soldiers gathered around a table engaging in various activities. In the center, there is a large tree with detailed branches. In the background, tents are scattered in a line. The artwork showcases precise brushstrokes and uses a monochromatic color palette of brown tones.

artworks.title: Attacking Travelers on the Highway
artworks.description: The image depicts a dynamic scene on a flat terrain. In the center, there is a horizon with trees and shrubbery. The scene is detailed with fine engravings, showing figures and natural elements in monochrome. Close to us, figures are shown in action, including a group tackling someone and a person on a horse being confronted. In the distance, more figures and foliage blend into the landscape's contour lines. There is a figure hanging from a tree on the horizon.

artworks.title: Pillaging a Monastery
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small church burning amidst chaos. The drawing features a dynamic and chaotic scene centered around the burning church, with flames and smoke coming from its roof. Several figures are shown climbing ladders and engaging with each other, indicating urgency and action. The architecture is European in style, with a simple facade and a classical triangular pediment. The scene is bustling with activity, depicting various individuals, possibly soldiers or townsfolk, carrying weapons and interacting frantically in the foreground. In the background, a cart or carriage, trees, and other structures are visible, suggesting a town or village setting. The drawing is intricately detailed with fine lines and shading, giving depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Ravaging and Burning a Village
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a focus on people engaging in various activities near a building with a tall tower and a cross. The artwork features detailed lines typical of an etching, with a color scheme of sepia and black. The scene includes figures busy with tasks like handling an ox-drawn cart loaded with goods, with other groups of people and animals in the distance near rustic buildings.

artworks.title: The Peasants' Revenge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a village scene. The drawing depicts a village setting where various figures are engaged in different actions. The architecture of the buildings shows rustic, thatched rooftops lining a road. In the background, a small church or chapel is nestled among trees. The drawing uses intricate lines and hatching to suggest texture and depth.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Large Miseries of War"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for "Les Misères et les Mal-heurs de la Guerre." The composition features a central text block with elaborately styled lettering, announcing the work of "Les Misères et les Mal-heurs de la Guerre" by Jacques Callot. On both sides of the text block, there are intricate drawings of figures, likely soldiers dressed in historical military attire. They are surrounded by various military paraphernalia, including helmets, drums, and flags, which frame the central text. The scene is highly detailed, showcasing the ornate style typical of the period, with a strong emphasis on line work and contrasts to highlight the objects and garments worn by the figures.

artworks.title: Recruitment of Troops
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military procession and camp. The scene depicts a group of soldiers marching in formation, with pikes and flags held high, crossing a large dirt area. To the left, the backdrop includes a large stone fortress with battlements and towers extending into the far distance. In the foreground, under the shade of a large tree, a group is gathered around a table with tents visible behind them. The drawing includes fine lines and detailed engravings, characteristic of etching techniques of classic military scenes, with an emphasis on the disciplined arrangement of figures and equipment.

artworks.title: The Battle
artworks.description: The scene depicts a battle with soldiers engaged in combat. The background shows a swirl of smoke, soldiers on horseback and foot, fallen soldiers, and a structure in the distance. The illustration is primarily monochromatic with detailed line work emphasizing complexity.

artworks.title: Scene of Pillage
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene outside a rustic building. The drawing depicts several figures engaged in a boisterous melee in front of a two-story stone building. The central character of the building features an open porch with a sign hanging from above. The figures are shown actively moving around the entrance, some carrying weapons or staffs. The setting includes mature trees with dense foliage in the foreground and background. The sky is lightly outlined. The scene conveys a sense of disorder and excitement, typical of an unrest outside such a building.

artworks.title: Plundering a Large Farmhouse
artworks.description: This is an image of an indoor scene set in an old kitchen or workshop. The room is busy with figures engaged in various actions, surrounded by pots, pans, and utensils. A fireplace on the right is emitting smoke. The figures are interacting in a chaotic manner. Some are in conflict, others are working, inspecting barrels, or lying on the ground. The detailed lines and shading depict motion and tension in the composition.

artworks.title: Destruction of a Convent
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a chaotic scene with historical buildings and individuals engaged in dynamic activities. The artwork showcases detailed architecture, including a church with tall, arched windows and a pediment adorned with sculptures. The scene is lively with numerous figures on horseback and on foot, involved in various actions. A crowd is depicted bustling around, with some individuals carrying weapons and others tending to goods and horses. The architectural elements, such as adjacent residential buildings and a distant gateway, provide depth and context. The drawing conveys the energy and tension of the scene through intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Plundering and Burning a Village
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a village scene showing various activities and interactions. People are seen bustling around, some carrying goods while others appear to be armed. Animals such as horses and goats are also present. In the center, a cart is shown being loaded or unloaded. The buildings have thatched roofs and there is a church-like structure with a cross in the background. The overall atmosphere is tense and chaotic.

artworks.title: Attack on a Coach
artworks.description: This print shows a battle with people on horseback and a horse-drawn carriage on a wide road lined with trees and a small hill. The horse-drawn carriage is in the center of the print, surrounded by people with long weapons. On the left, people on horseback are engaged in combat with men on the ground - some have similar long weapons, and others are firing guns. Three people stand on a hill in the background, looking down at the conflict. In the bottom center of the print, a person lays on the ground, next to a long weapon and a bundle spilling its contents on the ground. Another person is on the ground near the front wheel of the carriage. On the right, a person is held down on the ground and threatened or impaled by another person holding a long weapon. Next to them, a horse rears up. On the far right, a person in shadow looks out at the scene from a group of trees. The person holds a long gun and wears a feathered hat.

artworks.title: Discovery of the Criminal Soldiers
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from slightly above eye level. The horizon is set at the top quarter of the image, the sky filled with swirling cloud patterns. At the bottom, various objects like hats and swords lie on the ground. In the center, a group of armed individuals is marching amidst detailed line work depicting movement and texture. The depiction includes intricate brushstrokes for leaves, clothing, and trees. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white. In the distance, more trees and a building are visible through dense foliage on the right.

artworks.title: The Strappado
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene with a gallows and soldiers. The artwork depicts a large public space within a town. There is a central focus on a gallows where a figure hangs high above a crowd. The background includes European-style buildings with steep roofs and towers, including a prominent church or town hall structure with a spire. The crowd consists of soldiers organized in columns holding weapons, such as pikes, and standard bearers with flags. The scene features intricate details, such as the costumes and hats of the soldiers, indicating a formal or ceremonial occasion. Onlookers line the streets and structures on the sides. Text at the bottom of the drawing likely provides a narrative or context in French. The drawing is executed in fine lines, creating a complex and bustling historical event.

artworks.title: The Hanging
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an execution scene under a tree. Numerous figures are hanging from the branches of a large tree, while soldiers and other figures surround the area. A ladder is propped against the tree. A friar is seen on the ladder. In the background, there are groups of soldiers and tents. The use of fine lines and attention to detail suggests the meticulous nature of the artwork. Text in French is included at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Firing Squad
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military camp and firing squad scene. The drawing shows a group of soldiers in a formation, with some aiming their rifles towards figures lying on the ground. Smoky clouds are visible, suggesting gunfire. There are tents and a watchtower in the background, indicating a military encampment. The foreground includes a dog standing attentively, and a person tied to a wooden post on the right side. The image is detailed with various soldiers either standing or on horseback, and banners are being held aloft. The stylized line work captures the movement and atmosphere of a military execution scenario.

artworks.title: The Stake
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of soldiers in front of a burning village. The soldiers are in military attire, holding flags and weapons. There is smoke coming from fires, and a church can be seen in the background. The sky has dramatic cloud-like lines.

artworks.title: The Wheel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical execution scene. It shows a large gathering of individuals around a central scaffold. The structure is a high wooden platform crowded with onlookers. Some are standing on horseback, others on foot. There is a raised stage where two figures are standing, one holding a raised object. The crowd appears engrossed in the event, with a sense of anticipation or observation. The surroundings include medieval style buildings with towers, and the scene includes many soldiers or guards holding long pikes. Rich details in the architecture and attire of the figures are shown in intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Hospital
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban scene with a gathering of figures in a town square. The drawing depicts a bustling street of what appears to be a historical or old European city. The architecture consists of classical buildings with ornate facades and intricate window designs. In the foreground, a crowd of figures in various poses are wearing cloaks and hats, some using sticks to aid their movement. The composition features an array of buildings including a prominent domed structure on the right and several multi-story buildings on the left with rows of windows. Additionally, there's a well-like structure in the street and further details of urban life captured through figures engaged in activities in the background. The drawing is etched with careful line work, providing a detailed view of the surroundings and the narrative of daily life in this imagined or historical setting.

artworks.title: Dying Soldiers by the Roadside
artworks.description: The image shows a historical village scene with detailed engravings. The horizon line is positioned about two-thirds up, drawing the eye towards distant treetops and building spires peeking above the trees. Buildings with stone and wood facades line the street, providing a sense of depth. The brushwork emphasizes architectural details, foliage, and figures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. Peasants, beggars, and townsfolk populate the scene, adding to the atmosphere. Soft, swirling clouds fill the sky.
